smoke.title: Smoke Levels
smoke.description: Gas and smoke levels are important indicators of air quality and potential fire hazards within a building.

humidity.title: Humidity Levels
humidity.description: Humidity is the concentration of water vapor in the air. It is usually expressed as a percentage of the maximum moisture the air can hold at a given temperature.

temperature.title: Temperature Levels
temperature.description: Temperature measures the warmth or coldness of an environment or object. It is typically measured in degrees Celsius (C) or Fahrenheit (F).

brightness.title: Brightness Levels
brightness.description: Brightness is the perceived intensity of light in an environment. It affects visibility and is typically measured in lumens or lux.

endangerment.title: Endangerment
endangerment.description: Endangerment summarizes the current severity of a detected condition in a home.
endangerment.normal: Normal: no immediate danger has been detected.
endangerment.warning: Warning: a condition needs attention and should be checked promptly.
endangerment.critical: Critical: a serious danger has been detected and immediate action is required.

danger-kind.title: Danger Kind
danger-kind.description: Danger kind identifies the type of hazard associated with the current endangerment.
danger-kind.none: None: no specific hazard is reported.
danger-kind.gas: Gas: a potentially hazardous gas condition is reported.
